name: Dianthus Red Beauty Perennial
description: A sport of the popular D. Firewitch. Bold red, fragrant single blooms are heat-resistant and even longer flowering than its award-winning parent.Who can resist Dianthus? The more the flowers are cut, the more they bloom. Blossoms sparkle against compact silvery blue-green foliage.

name: PROVEN WINNERS 1 Gal. Yuki Snowflake (Deutzia) Live Shrub, White Flowers
description: Yuki Snowflake Deutzia from Proven Winners provides dense, pure white flowers in spring and burgundy foliage in fall. It is perfect for landscapes and spring gardens. Yuki Snowflake also is deer resistant.

name: Cottage Farms 10-Piece Tall Phlox Value Mix
description: A midsummer day's dream. Brighten your landscape in the middle of summer, when the garden needs a refreshing splash of color and fragrance. Pink, red, purple, and white shades abound in this hardy perennial phlox mix. Phlox weathers the winter and loves high heat, and its blooms add a sweet fragrance to your garden. From Cottage Farms.

name: Allium 'Millenium'
description: Expect these merry rosy-lavender flowerheads, arising by the dozen, to last for a month or more! 'Millenium' is a splendid late-summer Allium, ready to pop up and deliver outstanding color just when much of the sunny border is giving up its show for the season. No wonder it's been named the 2018 Perennial Plant of the Year!You can't do wrong by tucking 'Millenium' among early-summer-blooming perennials and bulbs, slipping it into containers for the patio, and wedging it along pathways and other heavily trafficked spots. It delivers carefree, unexpected color just when you need it most!The flowerheads are perfectly round and reach about 2 inches in diameter, studded on all sides with purple florets tinged with red. Like all Allium, it has a scent (it's an onion, after all!), which keeps away nibbling rabbits, deer, and other creatures of the night. On the other hand, butterflies and bees find the blooms enticing, so you'll likely attract some "mobile color" when they come to visit the flowers!This ornamental onion reaches about a foot high and wide, with a dense bouquet of dark green stems topped by bobbing blooms. Unlike older varieties, it won't scatter seed all over the garden to be weeded out by you next spring; it concentrates all its energy on setting flowers instead of going to seed, and the results are magnificent!'Millenium' is a good choice for the vegetable patch and herb garden as well as more traditional "ornamental" locations. It keeps pests at bay, offers nice color, and brings in "good bugs" such as bees. Just give it plenty of sunshine, well-drained soil on the light side, and wait for the flowers! They make good cuts for the vase, too.Bred by plantsman Mark McDonough, 'Millenium' is a truly carefree Allium that delights with profuse flowers, long bloomtime, and late season. Make it part of your garden! Zones 5-8.

name: 10-Pack Double Mixed Hollyhock Bulbs (Lb22251) 08428
description: Vigorous upright perennial. Container friendly. Light green hairy Foliage. Adds color texture to gardens. Good for cut flowers.

name: Leucanthemum x superbum 'Belgian Lace'
description: Every flower on this floriferous Shasta Daisy is a cushion of cream melting into a buttery yellow center. Blooming all summer, the split, frilly petal tips give flouncy volume as flowers hover above the compact, mounding leaves. PP 27,038 Until recently, we listed Shasta Daisies (Leucanthemum x superbum) under the genus Chrysanthemum, but as long-time gardeners, we've become used to having plant names change. What hasn't changed is the plants themselves, which are some of the showiest and most reliable perennials for the summer garden. At peak bloom, they produce a mass of daisies so clean and white, they compete in brilliance with the sun. All they require is good, rich soil and lots of sun. For more information on the growing and care of Leucanthemum, click growing guide.Hardiness Zone:5,6,7,8,9,9S,9W Blooms In:August July June Spacing:16-18" Height:12-24" Ships as:1 PINT 28.86 CU IN.

name: Hemerocallis Hyperion Perennial by Bluestone Perennials
description: A border favorite for decades. Sweetly scented and yellow flowering with a tiny green throat. Blooms Mid: July. Award winner. Reblooms. Fragrant.Hemerocallis Hyperion, a tetraploid, will adapt to a wide range of growing conditions. Very drought tolerant. Hemerocallis are selected for their abundance of blossoms, vibrant colors, and hardiness in a variety of climates and soils.

name: Heuchera Forever Purple
description: Plant Patent Applied For. This Coral Bells raises the bar for purple foliage plants, keeping its rich color for all four seasons! Vastly superior to other purple varieties, Forever Purple boasts a vigorous multi-crown habit and extremely color-fast foliage. Magenta pink flower spikes complement the foliage at the peak of its color in summer. The leaves are glossy, well-fluted, and untroubled by diseases. Heuchera is a native Genus with woody roots and a rounded mound of attractive, ruffled foliage. In late spring the foliage is augmented with thin flowerstalks bearing small, colorful, bell-shaped blooms, earning it the common name 'Coral Bells'. Beloved by hummingbirds, Heuchera is a decorative favorite for woodland gardens and other shady spots. It prefers moist, organically rich soil, but beyond that is very low maintenance and very cold hardy. Highly tolerant of both heat and humidity, this gorgeous variety thrives in the South. This breakthrough cultivar is a must-have for mixed containers, waterside plantings, and shady borders! Photos show Heuchera in various climate conditions.

name: Asiatic Lily Mix (Lilium) - Bag of 5
description: Plant this gorgeous mixture of Asiastic Lily bulbs for a rainbow of color in the early summer. The variety of colorful blooms is gorgeous in the garden, perfect for bouquets, and extremely easy to grow! (Lilium)

description: Great shade plant. Easy to grow.
